fields.subject: FW: SecureWatch first assessment
fields.note: Marguerite — their instructions are below. They need your go-ahead for the FBI report. — Tomás

original.subject: First assessment
original.body:
1. The svc-backup credential was used from HUOG-PROC01 after a phishing login to a processing account on Friday.
2. Encryption so far: HUOG-NAS01, HUOG-PROC01, GCS-02.
3. Keep HUOG-PROC01 powered on; we will capture memory remotely.
4. Do not connect OB-1 until we confirm the environment is clean — expected early afternoon.
5. With your approval we will open a report with the FBI field office.

SecureWatch MSSP

instructorNote: The MSSP advises; the Group decides. Watch for the FBI report authorized and the no-pay position stated.

snapshot.title: Formal Cyber Incident Declaration — HUOG-ISP Section 9.3

fields.to: gm@huog.example, ops@huog.example, it@huog.example, safety@huog.example, pio@huog.example, security@huog.example
fields.subject: Formal Cyber Incident Declaration - HUOG-ISP Section 9.3
fields.note:
Team,

This is a Level 3 cyber incident under HUOG-ISP Section 9.3. The MSSP has confirmed the ransomware infection on HUOG-NAS01 and HUOG-PROC01. The NAS snapshot schedule was disabled on 2026-04-10 at 22:15. The infection spread to GCS-02 via an unauthorized NAS mount. The environment is not clean. We are coordinating with the FBI field office (585-555-0155) and will not restore from any backup until a clean environment is confirmed.

The Group must now activate unified command: the General Manager is the Incident Commander. The Systems & Cybersecurity Lead is the technical co-IC. All actions must be logged in the incident folder at \HUOG-NAS01\ops\incident-log\2026-04-20\ per HUOG-ERP Section 10.3 and HUOG-ISP Section 9.3.

We are now in recovery mode. The offline drive OB-1 is not valid for recovery as it is three weeks outdated. The off-site backup service’s last good snapshot is from 2026-04-07.

You have four hours from now to decide whether to notify CP&L and CVAC that D-3 is at risk.

We will report progress every hour.

original.subject: Critical Alert: Suspicious Script Detected on HUOG-PROC01
original.body:
Hi IT,

We’ve detected a script named backup_fix_temp.py in /tmp/scripts/ on HUOG-PROC01 (10.17.41.11). It was modified at 09:10:17 and contains commands to re-enable the NAS snapshot cron job. However, the script was not part of the approved system baseline and has no known signature in our threat intelligence. We’ve blocked execution and quarantined the file. Do not run it.

Source: HUOG-PROC01
Alert: Unauthorized script execution

Best,

MSSP SOC

[Attachment: backup_fix_temp.py, timestamp 09:10:17]

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject activates unified command and confirms the Group's formal incident response posture. Watch for the GM to declare a Level 3 incident and assign roles per HUOG-ISP Section 9.3.
